sections.title: China's International Economic Cooperation / 中国对外经济合作
sections.focus: Cross-border trade, investment, industrial cooperation, strategic agreements, infrastructure and supply-chain cooperation involving China.
queries: China overseas investment trade cooperation agreements industrial cooperation latest
China foreign direct investment bilateral economic cooperation new agreements
China cross border investment manufacturing supply chain cooperation latest
sections.focus_zh: 重点关注涉及中国的跨境贸易、投资、产业合作、战略协议、基础设施及供应链合作。

sections.title: US External Economic Policy / 美国对外经济政策
sections.focus: US tariffs, sanctions, export controls, outbound and inbound investment restrictions, trade policy and US-China economic relations.
queries: United States international economic policy tariffs sanctions investment restrictions latest
US China trade policy export controls investment restrictions latest
US outbound investment rules foreign investment screening policy latest
sections.focus_zh: 重点关注美国关税、制裁、出口管制、对外及对内投资限制、贸易政策和中美经济关系。

sections.title: Wall Street and Global Institutional Capital / 华尔街与全球机构资本
sections.focus: Material capital allocation decisions by major banks, investment banks, asset managers, sovereign wealth funds, public investment funds, conglomerates, family offices and large business families. Exclude routine stock-price commentary.
queries: sovereign wealth fund major investment acquisition divestment announced today
BlackRock Vanguard State Street major capital allocation infrastructure private markets investment
Wall Street bank asset manager strategic investment acquisition divestment latest
family office conglomerate large institutional investment private equity capital allocation
sections.focus_zh: 重点关注大型银行、投资银行、资产管理公司、主权财富基金、公共投资基金、综合性企业集团、家族办公室及大型商业家族的重大资本配置决策；排除常规股价评论。

sections.title: Major Global Investments and M&A / 全球重大投资与并购
sections.focus: Large cross-border M&A, private equity, venture capital, greenfield industrial investment, factories, data centers, energy, logistics, manufacturing and strategic infrastructure.
queries: major cross border investment acquisition private equity industrial project announced
large manufacturing factory investment foreign direct investment project announced
global private equity infrastructure energy logistics investment deal latest
cross border M&A strategic investment sovereign fund industrial investment
sections.focus_zh: 重点关注大型跨境并购、私募股权、风险投资、绿地工业投资，以及工厂、数据中心、能源、物流、制造业和战略基础设施项目。

sections.title: Federal Reserve and Monetary Policy / 美联储与货币政策
sections.focus: Federal Reserve decisions, rates, balance sheet and monetary policy only where there is a meaningful transmission to sovereign funds, institutional asset allocation, conglomerates, family offices, cross-border investment or government financing.
queries: Federal Reserve monetary policy interest rates institutional capital allocation impact latest
Federal Reserve policy global capital flows emerging markets sovereign wealth funds
central bank rate decision cross border investment capital flows institutional investors
sections.focus_zh: 仅关注美联储决策、利率、资产负债表和货币政策对主权财富基金、机构资产配置、企业集团、家族办公室、跨境投资或政府融资产生的实质性影响。

sections.title: Investment Destination Policy Responses / 投资目的地国家政策响应
sections.focus: How recipient countries respond to inbound capital and strategic investment: tax incentives, subsidies, grants, industrial policy, local-content rules, foreign investment screening, ownership restrictions, permits, export incentives and regulatory changes. Link the policy to the relevant investment where evidence exists.
queries: government investment incentives tax credits subsidies foreign direct investment manufacturing policy latest
foreign investment screening national security review industrial policy incentives recipient countries
country announces tax incentives subsidy package foreign manufacturing investment project
local content rules foreign investment industrial policy investment incentives latest
sections.focus_zh: 关注资本和战略投资接收国的政策响应，包括税收优惠、补贴、拨款、产业政策、本地含量要求、外资审查、持股限制、许可、出口激励及监管变化；只有证据支持时才将政策与具体投资关联。

editorial_rules: Do not prioritize ordinary stock price movements, individual share prices or routine bond price movements.
Prioritize real capital allocation, major policy decisions and material institutional actions.
Label each item as completed, formally announced/planned, reported/under negotiation, or unverified.
For every material investment, identify destination country, sector, investor, value, status and source only when disclosed.
For recipient-country policy, identify the government, policy instrument, effective date and linked investment only when supported by evidence.
Never invent amounts, dates, investor identities, policy details or causal relationships.
Separate facts from analysis. Mark causal interpretation as analysis, not established fact.
Do not provide personalized investment advice.
Prefer extracted article body text over search snippets; clearly mark when full text cannot be retrieved.
Every news item must retain a direct URL to the specific original article, not a homepage, category page or search result page.
The email HTML must render each Markdown article-title link as a clickable anchor and include a readable plain-text alternative.
Distinguish publication date from event date and never infer missing dates or investment facts.
Pause paragraph-by-paragraph English-to-Chinese translation, vocabulary lists and American IPA until explicitly resumed.
